statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let d := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ‖S n (fun k => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) t - S n (high n) t‖; ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ t : ℝ, d n t ≤ 4*Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)*Real.log (n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 所有频率上换成完整冯·芒戈尔特权的显式误差
plain_statement.en: Uniform cost of replacing the upper prime spectrum by full von Mangoldt weights

brief.zh: 对高次素数幂，Mathlib 的 ψ−θ ≤ 2√n log n 控制系数绝对值和。补回的小素数满足 k³≤n，粗略计到 √n 已足够；任意相位均适用。
brief.en: Bound the added prime powers by the Chebyshev ψ−θ estimate. Restored low primes satisfy k³≤n and lie below √n. Both costs are uniform in the phase.
